### Monthly averages from 1993 to 2020

Downloaded from [Copernicus](https://resources.marine.copernicus.eu/product-download/GLOBAL_MULTIYEAR_BGC_001_029) with parameters:

  * Whole Available Region
  
  * Time Range 1993-2020
  
  * Depth: 
  
    - Default = Surface
  
  * Environmental Variables:
  
    - NO3 - Nitrate (mmol m-3)
    
    - PO4 - Phosphate (mmol m-3)
    

Downloaded from [Copernicus](https://resources.marine.copernicus.eu/product-download/GLOBAL_MULTIYEAR_PHY_001_030) with parameters:

  * Whole Available Region
  
  * Time Range 1993-2020
  
  * Depth: 
  
    - Default = Surface
  
  * Environmental Variables:
  
    - thetao - Temperature (&deg; C)

